ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants ENVIRONMENT.

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Paper burning to ash

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)

   D. Only carbon dioxide

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)

   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

15. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

17. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

18. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
